cmd:
set +e
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits; else echo NO_NVIDIA_SMI; fi
printf "CPU_LOAD "; uptime | sed 's/^.*load average: //'
printf "CPU_NPROC "; ps -u "$USER" -o pid= | wc -l
